''See also: [[Void Dragon’s Dance Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Void [[dragons|Dragon]]’s Dance, also referred to as the Dance of the [[dragons|Dragon]] of [[Emptiness]], is a powerful technique characterized by its immense destructive capabilities. When activated, it manifests as a violent cyclone of [[fire and destruction]] that can consume everything in its path, leaving behind nothing but smoke, dust, and ash. The technique is noted for its ability to release [[destruction aura]] alongside intense heat as the flames consume their targets. In a perfected state, it is intended to devour specific objects without wasting energy on rising towers of flame. The technique has been utilized in various combat scenarios, including against [[dreadbeasts]] and during high-level trials, often requiring significant mental and spiritual effort from the user to maintain.}}
